f.title: Identify the active substance, ATC code and medicinal products covered on the PSUR cover page
f.statement: The PSUR cover page template identifies the active substance(s) by INN and the ATC code(s), and lists the medicinal products covered with invented name, marketing authorisation number(s), date(s) of authorisation (with the International Birth Date underlined) and the marketing authorisation holder.
f.clause: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR

rows.quote:
PERIODIC SAFETY UPDATE REPORT
 for
 ACTIVE SUBSTANCE(S): <INN>
 ATC CODE(S): <Code(s)>


 MEDICINAL PRODUCTS COVERED:
 Invented name of the Marketing Date(s) of Marketing
 medicinal product(s) authorisation authorisation authorisation
 number(s) (Underline the holder
 International Birth
 Date)
rows.location: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR
rows.review_note: Review: template content, no modal verb; Recommended (GVP template referenced from GVP Module VII). Double-check: quote is the table header as captured.

f.title: State the procedure, IBD, EURD, reporting interval and report date on the PSUR cover page
f.statement: The PSUR cover page template states the EU authorisation procedure (centralised, mutual recognition, decentralised or purely national), the International Birth Date (IBD), the European Union reference date (EURD), the interval covered by the report (from date to data lock point) and the date of the report, with any other identifying or clarifying information if necessary.
f.clause: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR

rows.quote:
AUTHORISATION PROCEDURE in the EU:
<Centralised/Mutual Recognition/Decentralised/Purely National>

INTERNATIONAL BIRTH DATE (IBD): <Date>
EUROPEAN UNION REFERENCE DATE (EURD): <Date>


 INTERVAL COVERED BY THIS REPORT:
 From <date> to <date (i.e. data lock point)>
 DATE OF THIS REPORT:
 <Date>


OTHER INFORMATION:
<Other identifying or clarifying information if necessary>
rows.location: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR
rows.review_note: Review: template content, no modal verb; Recommended. Double-check: fields copied faithfully.

f.title: Give MAH and QPPV contact details and the QPPV signature on the PSUR cover page
f.statement: The PSUR cover page template gives the marketing authorisation holder's name and address and the e-mail of the contact person for the PSUR procedure, the name and contact details of the QPPV (address, telephone, fax, e-mail), and the signature of the QPPV or designated person.
f.clause: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR
f.processes: Aggregate reporting; Submission operations; Safety governance

rows.quote:
MARKETING AUTHORISATION HOLDER'S NAME AND ADDRESS:
<Name>
<Address>
<E-mail address> (contact person for the PSUR procedure)


NAME AND CONTACT DETAILS OF THE QPPV:
<Name>
<Address>
<Telephone number>
<Fax number>
<E-mail address>
SIGNATURE (QPPV or designated person): <Signature>
rows.location: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR
rows.review_note: Review: template content, no modal verb; Recommended. Double-check: QPPV or designated person signs.

f.title: Indicate the RMS and CMS in the PSUR distribution list for MRP/DCP products
f.statement: The PSUR cover page carries a distribution list of EU competent authorities (with number of copies); for medicinal products authorised through the mutual recognition or decentralised procedure, the Reference Member State and the Concerned Member States should be indicated.
f.clause: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR (footnote 1)
f.applicability: PSURs for products authorised through the mutual recognition or decentralised procedure

rows.quote:
DISTRIBUTION LIST1
 <Competent authority in the EU> <Number of copies>




1
 For medicinal products authorised through the mutual recognition or decentralised procedure the Reference Member State
and the Concerned Member States should be indicated.
rows.location: Annex II – Template: Cover page of PSUR (footnote 1)
